issue.author: tenplus1
issue.body_normalized:
It seems that falling nodes have a tendency to replace blocks beneath them even if they have buildable_to set to false, most especially airblocks and thin node boxes that are important (invisible lights, barriers etc.)

Could we add a check and only replace nodes with buildable_to set to true ?  This bug or glitch has been around since 2016 hence no template, to duplicate create following node and drop sand on top of it from a height:
```
minetest.register_node(":invisiblocks:light", {
	description = "Invisible Light Source",
	drawtype = "airlike",
	buildable_to = false,
	inventory_image = "default_glass.png",
	wield_image = "default_glass.png",
	paramtype = "light",
	sunlight_propagates = true,
	walkable = false,
	light_source = 14,
	sounds = default.node_sound_glass_defaults(),
	groups = {invisible = 1, unbreakable = 1},
	selection_box = {
		type = "fixed",
		fixed = {-0.5, -0.5, -0.5, 0.5, -5/16, 0.5}
	},
})
```
